title: Anthropic Is Only Part of the Story. Cognizant Has a Much Bigger AI Plan.
excerpt: Cognizant is strengthening its AI consulting business by partnering across leading AI models, positioning itself to benefit regardless of which AI platform u...
content_html:
On July 27, Cognizant (CTSH) deepened its relationship with Anthropic. The company is now a part of a small group of Global Premier Partners in the Claude Partner Network. The plan is to embed Claude across Cognizant's own engineering and business platforms. Cognizant intends to put the model to work in client projects across manufacturing, life sciences, and insurance. More than 30,000 of its staff have already been trained on Claude. Cognizant's pitch rests on where the difficulty now lies. Most companies can access a strong model but struggle to put it to work inside the systems they already run. That gap is what Cognizant sells.

The more interesting part is what this deal sits alongside. It is the latest in a series of AI moves Cognizant has made this month. It has spent July building out its "Frontier Certified" workforce model, deepening its Google (GOOG) (GOOGL) Cloud deal, and signing a sovereign-AI partnership with Domyn.

That pattern is the strategy. Cognizant is training its people across every major model, including Claude, Google's Gemini, OpenAI's Codex, and GitHub Copilot. This way, it can hand a client whichever one they want and do the integration either way. In a market obsessed with which lab leads, Cognizant is taking a different approach. It gets paid to do the integration no matter who comes out ahead. The one thing to watch is how quickly this shows up in revenue. With more than 30,000 staff trained in a matter of weeks, Cognizant is strengthening its position faster than most of its rivals. 

About CTSH Stock

Cognizant Technology Solutions is a global IT services and consulting company. The company operates through four segments. These include Financial Services, Health Sciences, Products and Resources, and Communications. It provides services such as AI solutions, consulting, software development, cloud and infrastructure management, and digital transformation. Founded in 1988, the company is headquartered in Teaneck, New Jersey. 

Despite an increase of over 38% in the last month, over the last 12 months, CTSH stock has lost 27% of its value, significantly underperforming the S&P 500's ($SPX) 17% gain during the same period. In the same period, the iShares Expanded Tech-Software Sector ETF (IGV) declined over 17%. Due to cautious enterprise technology spending and ongoing macroeconomic uncertainty, Cognizant has faced slower demand for IT services, limiting revenue growth.

content_html_zh:
7 月 27 日，Cognizant (CTSH) 加深了与 Anthropic 的关系。 该公司现在是 Claude 合作伙伴网络中全球优质合作伙伴小组的一部分。 该计划旨在将 Claude 嵌入 Cognizant 自己的工程和业务平台。 Cognizant 打算将该模型应用于制造、生命科学和保险领域的客户项目。 超过 30,000 名员工已经接受了有关克劳德的培训。 Cognizant 的立场取决于现在的困难所在。 大多数公司都可以使用强大的模型，但很难将其应用到他们已经运行的系统中。 Cognizant 所销售的正是这种差距。

更有趣的部分是这笔交易的相关内容。 这是 Cognizant 本月采取的一系列人工智能举措中的最新一项。 该公司花了 7 月份的时间构建了“Frontier Certified”劳动力模型，深化了与 Google (GOOG) (GOOGL) 的云交易，并与 Domyn 签署了主权人工智能合作伙伴关系。

这种模式就是策略。 Cognizant 正在对各个主要模型的员工进行培训，包括 Claude、Google 的 Gemini、OpenAI 的 Codex 和 GitHub Copilot。 这样，它就可以为客户提供他们想要的任何一个，并以任何一种方式进行集成。 在一个痴迷于哪个实验室处于领先地位的市场中，Cognizant 采取了不同的方法。 无论谁胜出，进行整合都会得到报酬。 值得关注的一件事是这在收入中体现的速度有多快。 Cognizant 在几周内培训了 30,000 多名员工，其巩固地位的速度比大多数竞争对手都要快。

关于CTSH股票

Cognizant Technology Solutions 是一家全球 IT 服务和咨询公司。 该公司通过四个部门运营。 其中包括金融服务、健康科学、产品和资源以及通信。 它提供人工智能解决方案、咨询、软件开发、云和基础设施管理以及数字化转型等服务。 该公司成立于 1988 年，总部位于新泽西州蒂内克。

尽管上个月上涨了 38% 以上，但在过去 12 个月中，CTSH 股票价值已下跌 27%，明显逊色于标准普尔 500 指数 ($SPX) 同期 17% 的涨幅。 同期，iShares Expanded Tech-Software Sector ETF (IGV) 下跌超过 17%。 由于谨慎的企业技术支出和持续的宏观经济不确定性，Cognizant 面临着 IT 服务需求放缓的问题，限制了收入增长。
